raw_text:
name: dotnet-csharp-source-generators

Guidance for creating `IIncrementalGenerator`-based Roslyn source generators and consuming `[GeneratedRegex]`, `[LoggerMessage]`, and System.Text.Json source generation. Related: [skill:dotnet-roslyn-analyzers], [skill:dotnet-csharp-modern-patterns], [skill:dotnet-csharp-coding-standards].

**Generator project:** Ship as an analyzer targeting `netstandard2.0`; use `<EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>true</EnforceExtendedAnalyzerRules>`, `<IsRoslynComponent>true</IsRoslynComponent>`, `<LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>`, `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers` and `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp` with `PrivateAssets="all"`.

**Always target `netstandard2.0`.** Generators load into the compiler process, which requires this TFM for compatibility. Use `LangVersion>latest` to write modern C# in the generator itself.
Always use `IIncrementalGenerator` over the legacy `ISourceGenerator`.

Implement `Initialize(IncrementalGeneratorInitializationContext context)` with `context.SyntaxProvider.ForAttributeWithMetadataName` for attributes or `context.SyntaxProvider.CreateSyntaxProvider` for general syntax. Filter with a tight predicate; transform candidates into small value records; use `.Where`, `.Select`, `.Collect()` as needed and `context.RegisterSourceOutput` to emit. Group related fields by fully qualified containing type; include the namespace in hint names to avoid collisions. Handle global namespaces. **Scope note:** An AutoNotify example limited to top-level, non-generic classes needs expansion for generic parameters and nested partial hierarchies. Report a diagnostic for unsupported shapes rather than emitting invalid code.

**Never pass `ISymbol` or `SyntaxNode` through the pipeline (they hold the compilation alive and break caching).** Use `record struct` or implement `IEquatable<T>` for custom types. **Same inputs must produce identical source.** Use `// <auto-generated/>` and `#nullable enable` headers. Prefer raw string literals for templates. Name generated files `{TypeName}.{Feature}.g.cs`.

Report errors and warnings through `SourceProductionContext` rather than throwing exceptions. Capture syntax-node `Location` for location-specific `context.ReportDiagnostic(Diagnostic.Create(...))`. `Location` is not value-equatable: exclude it from pipeline-record equality or report before projecting to value types. Use `RegisterPostInitializationOutput` for marker attributes and helper types independent of user code.

**Testing:** Use `CSharpGeneratorDriver` to run generators in-memory and verify output. Parse input with `CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText`, create a `CSharpCompilation`, call `driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation`, inspect diagnostics and `driver.GetRunResult().GeneratedTrees`. [Verify.SourceGenerators](https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.SourceGenerators) supports snapshot tests.

**`[GeneratedRegex]`:** Method must be `static partial` returning `Regex`. Place on `partial class` (or `partial struct`). Supports all `RegexOptions` except `RegexOptions.Compiled` (which is ignored -- the source generator replaces it).

**`[LoggerMessage]`:** Methods must be `static partial` in a `partial class`. Parameters matching `{Placeholder}` in the message are logged as structured data. `Exception` parameter is logged automatically (do not include in message template). Event IDs are auto-assigned if not specified; specify explicit IDs for stable telemetry.

**System.Text.Json:** Register all types that need serialization in `[JsonSerializable]` attributes. Use `TypeInfoResolverChain` (net8.0+) to combine multiple contexts. Required for Native AOT -- reflection-based serialization is trimmed. Pass generated type metadata, e.g. `AppJsonContext.Default.Order`, to `JsonSerializer.Serialize`/`Deserialize`; use `[JsonDerivedType]` for polymorphism.

**Packaging:** When shipping a generator as a NuGet package, place the assembly under `analyzers/dotnet/cs/`. Set `<IncludeBuildOutput>false</IncludeBuildOutput>` and `<DevelopmentDependency>true</DevelopmentDependency>`; package with `<None Include="$(OutputPath)\$(AssemblyName).dll" PackagePath="analyzers/dotnet/cs" />`. To inspect generated files, set `<EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>true</EmitCompilerGeneratedFiles>` and `<CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>Generated</CompilerGeneratedFilesOutputPath>` in the consuming project. Add `Generated/` to `.gitignore`.

References: [Source Generator Cookbook](https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/blob/main/docs/features/incremental-generators.cookbook.md), [Incremental Generators](https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/blob/main/docs/features/incremental-generators.md).
